newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-ICA upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ICA upgraded to buy.

text.p: Smith Barney upgraded Mexican construction firm Empresas ICA to buy from outperform based on an analysis of the possible impact of the Mexican toll roads restructuring on ICA's valuation.

-- Analyst Carmen Slade said she based her recommendation "on a payment to ICA by the government of 87.5 percent of ICA's federal toll road book value investment, which we assume would be made in the form of bonds with a realizable market value of 48 percent."
-- The Mexican government is expected to unveil the new roads plan in the coming weeks.
